subject: Fixed dumpring corrupted dump.rdb file (#131)
reason: The diff only changes MetadataManager's RDB aux-section count (hardcoded 1 -> GetSectionsCount(), which returns 0 when the global metadata has no entries), fixing an RDB header/body mismatch that corrupts dump.rdb. MetadataManager and its GLOBAL_METADATA aux-save callback are registered only when valkey-search runs with --use-coordinator in cluster mode (valkey_search.cc:514 guards instantiation; RegisterRDBCallback lives in its constructor).
